submittedParameters.prompt:
Edit the provided generated Daoist mechanical unit designs into production BODY-ONLY sprite assets. Keep the exact refined jade-green/ivory/warm-gold hand-painted art style, silhouette identity, strict orthographic dorsal top view facing north, materials and mechanical details of the supplied references. The mail and party UI references are style only, never draw their UI or people. Each output object must be a COMPLETE seamless hull with solid painted armor underneath removed attachments, never a cut hole or black patch. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no floor/shadows/glow backdrop, no text, no grid, no labels. Clean antialiased edges, no floating specks. Requested3072×2048,3:2. Five isolated complete bodies in invisible 3 columns by 2 rows: top-left,top-center,top-right,bottom-left,bottom-center; last cell empty. 12% margin in each cell, absolutely no contact between objects. No reimagining into front views.
OVERRIDE layout: exactly TWO large complete hulls side by side, requested 2048×1024,2:1, equal cells. LEFT is Quell from image1 bottom-left; RIGHT is Disrupt from image1 bottom-right. Preserve their original nose-up hull, engines, mechanical construction and distinct scale. REMOVE every missile launcher basket/turret from both bodies, reveal complete smooth armor below with round mount sockets. For DISRUPT also REMOVE its outer rear pair of swept movable tail wings while retaining the central fuselage, fixed front wings and engine pods. Its removed tail fins will be provided separately. No detached components in this image. Style refs2/3.
